preconditions.expression: isinstance(n, int) and isinstance(m, int) and isinstance(k, int)
preconditions.description: n, m, and k are integers.
The product of m and k is at most n, ensuring a valid partition exists.
a is a list of exactly n integers.
Each element in a is between -10^9 and 10^9 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output consists of exactly two lines.
The first line contains the maximum possible sum of beauties.
The second line contains exactly k-1 integers representing split points.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= p < n for p in parts) and all(parts[i] < parts[i+1] for i in range(len(parts)-1))
postconditions.description: The split points are strictly increasing integers between 1 and n-1.

postconditions.expression: all(subarray_len >= m for subarray_len in subarray_lengths)
postconditions.description: Every subarray in the partition has at least m elements.

postconditions.expression: sum(subarray_beauty(sub, m) for sub in subarrays) == max_beauty
postconditions.description: The sum of beauties of the partitioned subarrays equals the reported maximum beauty.

postconditions.expression: sum(subarray_beauty(sub, m) for sub in subarrays) >= sum(subarray_beauty(sub, m) for sub in any_valid_partition)
postconditions.description: The reported sum is the global maximum over all valid partitions.
